decisions.reason: The fruit-puree yogurt sits close to the firm's core organic dairy knowledge and has already won an award, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it.
The onion and pepper cheese builds on the firm's cheese expertise and is presented on the home page as a flagship, which points to commitment and learning potential.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is very close to the established offer, so the firm can easily assimilate market feedback and keep improving it.
The spicy cheese line builds on existing cheese know-how, and its several models allow the firm to adjust variants rather than drop the whole line.
The mild creamy soft cheese extends the firm's related knowledge in soft cheese and is backed by its launch messaging, though it faces a competitive niche.
The washed-rind soft cheese is a somewhat more specialised extension, but it still relies on related cheesemaking knowledge, so the firm can likely learn from early results.
